name: Once Upon a Time in DreamTown
source:
Elina is an excellent student, who came to study in Dream Town. When her government scholarship was cut, she began looking for a part-time job in her free time. One day she receives a phone call with an offer to work with a guy who has not left the house for several years due to psychological problems. She accepts this offer with great caution and reluctance. But she still has no idea what she is getting involved in...​

[Edited from F95Zone]

[i]Note: All actors in the game were hired for the development of the game, and all the photographs were produced as part of the development process. No public assets have been used.[/i]
